messages.content: You are a careful, fair evaluator.

You are grading a support assistant's reply for Northwind Outdoor (an outdoor-gear and bike store). Judge a SINGLE failure mode only and ignore every other way the reply might be good or bad.

FAILURE MODE: DID NOT ANSWER (did_not_answer)
Definition: the reply does not address the customer's actual ask: it evades, defers, or only partially answers. Directly answering the ask = PASS.

Grade ONLY this failure mode for the reply below.

--- TICKET ---
I am writing to you because I am extremely frustrated with the lack of clear information on your website. I am a first-time buyer, and I refuse to waste my time or money on a purchase that might turn out to be a disaster. I have heard terrible things about your shipping practices, and I am not about to be the next victim of poor customer service. Before I even consider putting a single item in my cart, I need absolute clarity on your international shipping rules. I have read your site, but it is vague and unhelpful. I want to know specifically: does free international shipping apply to orders over $150.00? I need a direct, yes-or-no answer. I am not interested in vague promises or hidden fees. I want to know the exact threshold. If the answer is yes, I will proceed. If it is no, I will take my business elsewhere. Do not waste my time with generic responses. I expect a prompt and accurate reply. I am tired of dealing with companies that hide the truth until after the sale. I want the facts, right now. Make sure you get this right, or I will be making a very public complaint about your lack of transparency. I am done with the runaround. Give me the straight answer about the $150.00 limit for free international shipping.

--- HANDBOOK CONTEXT RECALLED BY THE ASSISTANT ---
### # International Orders

1. **Shipping Costs and Thresholds**: Northwind Outdoor charges a flat shipping fee of $45.00 for all international orders under $150.00. For orders totaling $150.00 or more, standard international shipping is free. This threshold applies to the subtotal before any discounts are applied. Customers must select their country at checkout to see the exact delivery estimate, which typically ranges from 7 to 14 business days depending on the destination.

2. **Customs Duties and Taxes**: All international shipments are subject to local customs duties, import taxes, and handling fees. These charges are calculated by the carrier and are not included in the Northwind Outdoor checkout total. On average, customers in the European Union pay an additional 20% in VAT, while customers in other regions may face varying rates. Northwind Outdoor is not responsible for these third-party charges, and we recommend checking your local customs regulations before placing an order to avoid unexpected costs upon delivery.

3. **Return Window and Process**: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to initiate a return for international orders. This window is strictly enforced to account for transit times. To start a return, you must contact our support team within this 30-day period to receive a prepaid return label. If you miss this 30-day deadline, we cannot accept the return, and no refund will be issued. Please ensure your item is in its original condition with all tags attached before shipping it back.

4. **Refund Processing Time**: Once we receive your returned item at our warehouse, it takes 5 to 7 business days to inspect and process the refund. After processing, it may take an additional 10 to 14 business days for the funds to appear in your bank account, depending on your financial institution. Please note that the original shipping fee of $45.00 is non-refundable unless the item was defective or we shipped the wrong product.

5. **Prohibited Items and Restrictions**: We do not ship lithium batteries, fuel canisters, or certain chemical cleaning agents to countries with strict aviation safety regulations. This includes most destinations in the Middle East and parts of Southeast Asia. If your order contains prohibited items, we will cancel the order and issue a full refund within 3 business days. We reserve the right to refuse service to any location where local laws prohibit the import of outdoor gear.

## Key facts

- Free international shipping applies to orders over $150.00.
- You have 30 days from delivery to request a return.
- Customs duties are extra and vary by country, often around 20%.
- Refunds take 5 to 7 business days to process after receipt.
- Original shipping fees are non-refundable for standard returns.

### # Order Changes

1. You may modify your order details, including shipping address and contact information, up to 24 hours after placing the order. After this 24-hour window, the order is locked in our system and cannot be edited manually. If you need to change the address after this period, you must cancel the order and place a new one, subject to our cancellation policy.

2. Changing the size or color of an item is permitted only if the new variant is in stock. If the requested variant is out of stock, we will offer a 10% discount on the next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and expires after 30 days if not used.

3. Upgrading your shipping method from Standard to Express incurs an additional fee of $15.00. This fee is calculated based on the difference in carrier rates. If you downgrade from Express to Standard, we will refund the difference, which is typically between $5.00 and $12.00, within 5 business days of the change request.

4. Adding items to an existing order is allowed only if the original order has not yet been shipped. You can add up to 3 additional items per order. Each added item must be under $50.00 in value. If the total order value exceeds $200.00 after additions, the standard free shipping threshold is met, and any previously charged shipping fees will be refunded.

5. Removing items from an order is free of charge if done before the order is processed for shipment. Once the order status changes to "Processing," removal is no longer possible. You must cancel the entire order and re-order the remaining items. Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if the order has already been picked from the warehouse.

6. Payment method changes are restricted to credit cards and PayPal. You cannot switch to store credit or gift cards after the order is placed. If you change your payment method, the new card must be verified within 48 hours. Failure to verify results in the order being canceled and any pre-authorized funds being released back to your bank within 7 business days.

## Key facts

- You have a strict 24-hour window to edit your shipping address or contact details before the order locks.
- Upgrading to Express shipping costs an extra $15.00, while downgrading refunds the difference, usually between $5.00 and $12.00.
- You can add up to 3 items to an unshipped order, provided each item costs less than $50.00.
- Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if you cancel after the order status becomes "Processing."
- Payment verification for new cards must be completed within 48 hours to avoid automatic cancellation.
